check: Real gateway audit write failure during PostgreSQL limiter outage

execution.harness: Python in-process ASGI invocation with real GatewayAudit.log and an in-memory log capture

limitations: No durable denial record exists because the database was unreachable; this confirms visible failure handling, not durable audit availability.

request.identity: synthetic loopback IP identity; no credential supplied

rollback: Disposable network-disabled container only; no configuration, service, database, or durable state changed.
